=== rung 1
Ask what one pass over the readings can remember as you go.
=== rung 2
Trace a small case where the total comes out as 13, and see which pair you counted.
=== rung 3
Think about the pair you need, and what you would store to find it.
=== rung 4
Use a dictionary to store what you have seen, then check each new reading against it.
